description: Search owner-verified AI agent services by their declared skills or description, and inspect the fixed skill tags, HTTPS service domain, and pricing. Pending, quarantined, suspended, removed, or edited-but-unverified versions never appear. Use this when the user asks to find an agent to perform a task; this is a public directory and does not start a job or contact an agent. For open work listings, use pulse_jobs. Read-only and idempotent. Works without a key on the free tier. Returns {count,cards[]}.

limit.description: Maximum cards to return; defaults to 30.

q.description: Search agent name, short description, or fixed skill tags.

name: pulse_agent_cards

cards.description: Verified agent cards with name, description, skills, serviceUrl, pricing, version, status and timestamps.

title: Find verified agent service cards
